body.statement: The estimator in def:adjoint-covariance retains the finite-bandwidth harmonic translation score and every generated-target cross product and satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\mathbb P_P(\lVert\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}-V(P)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}>\varepsilon)\to0\) and \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\mathbb P_P(\lVert\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}^{R}-V(P)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}>\varepsilon)\to0\) for every \(\varepsilon>0\). The harmonic variance and its Green cross-covariances vanish after division by \(L_n\), but retaining them makes the finite-bandwidth covariance exact. Uniform positive definiteness of \(V(P)\), covariance consistency, and \(\theta_n=n^{-1}\) imply \(\max_{1\le j\le J}\lVert(\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj},jj}^{R})^{-1}-V_j(P)^{-1}\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\), so the ridge is asymptotically negligible while every block inverse exists in every sample.
body.justification: A covariance formula is operational only if the unknown elliptic coefficients, pullbacks, and moving poles can be estimated on the critical scale.
body.gap: GonzalezSanzMordantSheng2026PotentialFCLT uses adjoints for bounded weighted potential contrasts and explicitly excludes pointwise gradients; this result handles singular gradient evaluations and nesting.
body.consumer: The estimator supplies standard errors for a reproducible Card--Krueger arrow plot and detects whether control-cell uncertainty was incorrectly omitted.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove normalized \(L^2\) stability and a uniform fourth-moment envelope for every cross-fitted adjoint score under estimated coefficients, pullbacks, harmonic scores, and moving poles.
obligation.obstruction: Cross-fitting gives conditional independence but does not control translation of a mollified \(1/r\) singularity. The frozen core supplies neither the necessary pilot pole rate nor the critical-scale transformed-kernel stability bound.
obligation.attempted: Proved that the displayed \(L^2\) stability and fourth-moment bounds imply empirical covariance consistency at rate \(O_{\mathbb P}((\sqrt n h_nL_n)^{-1})\); also derived the uniform eigenvalue lower bound, ridge negligibility, inverse consistency, and exact conditional Gaussian multiplier law.
obligation.partial_result:
Write \(\widehat\Psi_{g,i}=\widehat\Psi_{g,h_n}^{(-r(i))}(X_{g,i})\) and \(\Psi_{g,i}=\Psi_{g,h_n}(X_{g,i})\).  Conditional on the opposite-fold pilots, observations in an evaluation fold are independent of the functions used to compute their scores.  Suppose the still-unproved singular-score estimates were available in the quantitative form
\[
 \max_{g,r}\left\lVert
 \widehat\Psi_{g,h_n}^{(-r)}-\Psi_{g,h_n}
 \right\rVert_{L^2(P_g)}=o_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{L_n}),
\tag{7}
\]
and, on pilot events of probability tending to one uniformly,
\[
 \max_{g,r}\mathbb E_{P_g}\!\left[
 \left\lVert\widehat\Psi_{g,h_n}^{(-r)}(X)\right\rVert^4
 +\left\lVert\Psi_{g,h_n}(X)\right\rVert^4
 \right]=O(h_n^{-2}).
\tag{8}
\]
The order-minus-one Green envelope and its annular integral also give
\(\lVert\Psi_{g,h_n}\rVert_{L^2(P_g)}=O(\sqrt{L_n})\).  By Cauchy--Schwarz, (7) then implies
\[
 \frac1{L_n}\left\lVert
 \operatorname{Cov}_{P_g}(\widehat\Psi_{g,h_n}^{(-r)}(X))
 -\operatorname{Cov}_{P_g}(\Psi_{g,h_n}(X))
 \right\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}=o_{\mathbb P}(1).
\tag{9}
\]
Conditional Chebyshev applied entrywise to the fixed-dimensional empirical outer products, using (8), yields an error
\[
 O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(\frac1{\sqrt n\,h_nL_n}\right)=o_{\mathbb P}(1),
\tag{10}
\]
because \(n h_n^2L_n^2\to\infty\).  Foldwise empirical centering changes neither (9) nor (10).  After multiplication by the displayed factors \(n/n_g\), (9)--(10) prove
\[
 \widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}-\Sigma_{h_n}(P)=o_{\mathbb P}(1).
\tag{11}
\]
Combining (11) with lem:full-critical-covariance would prove covariance consistency.

The remaining conclusions would then be algebraic.  Since \(\theta_n=n^{-1}\),
\[
 \left\lVert\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}^R-V(P)\right\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}
 \leq \left\lVert\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}-V(P)\right\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}+n^{-1}.
\]
Furthermore, ass:density-positivity, ass:outer-ellipticity, and \(\rho_{T1}\leq\bar\rho\) imply the uniform block bound
\[
 \lambda_{\min}(V_j(P))
 \geq \frac{\lambda^2}{4\pi C\bar\rho}>0.
\tag{12}
\]
The resolvent identity and (12) therefore give uniform convergence of every ridged block inverse.  Finally, Gaussian multiplier independence gives the exact finite-sample identity
\[
 Z^\star\mid\{X_{g,i}\}\sim N(0,\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj}}).
\]
The unresolved content is (7)--(8) for adjoint scores computed with estimated coordinate pullbacks, elliptic coefficients, harmonic scores, and moving poles.  Cross-fitting supplies the conditional independence used above but does not itself prove those singular-score estimates.
